_meta.title: Working analysis: Telehealth therapy LP at 8.2% start-trial baseline
_meta.why_strong_example: Healthcare-consumer analysis showing how privacy-sensitive niche has DIFFERENT trust anatomy than retail; identifies HIPAA + insurance logos + cancellation policy as load-bearing; warns against pathologizing language and aggressive urgency.

trust_anatomy.why_working: Privacy-paranoid audience checks; explicit callout removes a primary objection

trust_anatomy.element: Insurance accepted logos (BCBS, Aetna, Cigna prominent)
trust_anatomy.why_working: Audience needs to see THEIR specific insurance; cash-pay shock is the #1 abandonment driver — logos defuse it before form-start

trust_anatomy.element: Licensed clinicians count + state coverage map
trust_anatomy.why_working: Audience worries about clinician quality; state-by-state coverage = legitimacy + 'available in my state'

trust_anatomy.element: Clear cancellation policy ('cancel anytime, no fees')
trust_anatomy.why_working: Mental health audience feels 'trapped' in many subscriptions; clear exit-path overcomes this
Younger demographic checks app store; volume + score combined
Healthcare-specific objection-handler; appears in fine print on most pages but bigger when above fold

preservation_zones.reason: 18% load. Privacy-paranoid audience checks for this explicitly; absence is dealbreaker.
17% load. Audience needs to see THEIR insurance — generic 'we accept all insurance' tanks vs specific logos.
12% load. Audience filters out states they're not in; state map = audience self-qualification.
10% load. Hiding cancellation tanks LTV/refunds even if it lifts initial signups — long-term harm.
5% load. Healthcare-specific objection-handler; small but specific.

change_safe_zones.reason: Reword each of the 3 intake questions while keeping count + sequence — test variants
Hero hero-headline is preserve; subhead is change-safe with appropriate tone
How clinician profiles are displayed (carousel vs grid vs text) — testable
'Get matched in 24h' vs 'Find a therapist' vs 'See if therapy is right for you' — testable

warnings_for_downstream: DO NOT propose removing HIPAA callout. 18% load on the privacy-sensitive audience.
DO NOT propose replacing insurance logos with 'we accept all insurance' generic copy. Audience needs specific brand recognition.
DO NOT propose pathologizing language ('treat your depression' / 'manage your anxiety'). Audience self-identifies as 'going through something', not 'mentally ill'. Triggers identity rejection.
DO NOT add aggressive urgency ('Limited slots — get matched today!'). Trust erosion + bounce rate spike on this audience.
DO NOT propose hiding cancellation policy for 'less friction'. +signups but huge refund/LTV problems.
Tests on intake question COPY (not count) and below-fold clinician layout are highest-leverage.
